en.headline:
Many stocks.
One visual rhythm.
en.intro: Compare price changes across a thematic watchlist with compact horizon charts, shared scrubbing and optional benchmarks.
en.concept: A horizon chart folds value ranges into a short strip. Green and red show direction; stronger layers show larger moves. This app uses four bands so many histories can sit in one list.
en.concept_note: Read the pattern, then hover or touch for the value. Band height alone does not show the complete change. The original horizon-graph research explains the layering technique.
en.reference: Heer, Kong & Agrawala: Sizing the Horizon (CHI 2009)
en.demo_note: Synthetic numbers for an explanation, not quotes or a trading signal. The return formula and band thresholds are adapted from the actual app. The small diagram uses straight segments rather than its smoothed D3 curve.
features: D is the latest regular trading session; W uses the latest five sessions. M, 6M, Y, 5Y and MAX request longer histories. The first available close in the returned series is each stock’s baseline.

S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow subtract the benchmark’s close-based percentage change on matching dates. +4 percentage points can mean +10% for the stock against +6% for the index. Missing benchmark dates fall back to zero in the current implementation.

Global uses shared dates and a shared value scale. Local per stock stretches each row’s own history and value range, making its internal pattern easier to see but weakening direct magnitude and date comparison.
Normal divides the value range evenly. Fibonacci bands use 23.6%, 38.2% and 61.8% boundaries. These are display thresholds, not a forecasting or retracement tool.
steps: Begin with M for a broader view than the latest session, then choose a benchmark or keep No benchmark.
Hover or touch a strip. All rows move to the same shared position; the readout adds the corresponding close price. Lift or leave the row to return to its latest value.
The default view keeps thematic sections and sorts their rows by latest change. Rank places all rows in one ordered list.
Add a ticker to an existing theme. Edit reveals removal controls. The hosted watchlist is a server workspace, not a private account archive.
captions: Actual M view, no benchmark, captured 6 November 2026. Displayed prices are a source snapshot.
Ranked view with S&P 500 comparison and a shared hover readout.
The real scale and per-stock domain controls at the bottom of the list.
Edit mode exposes removal controls; no shared symbols were changed for these captures.
en.data_title: Know where the rows come from.
data: The chart uses returned close prices. It does not compute dividend-reinvested total return, position sizes or account profit. Avg is a mean of loaded rows, not a cash-weighted portfolio result.

The server requests Yahoo Finance chart data, filters regular-session intraday bars and resamples long series. A line can therefore be a reduced view of a larger series. Intraday queries refresh periodically; this is not a tick-by-tick trading feed.

Locally, watchlist JSON is written beside the server. On Vercel it lives in /tmp for a warm instance and can reset or differ between instances. There is no account, durable per-user watchlist or backup/restore screen.
The market badge uses a weekday/time rule for New York hours; it does not know exchange holidays. Missing or failed symbol data can leave a row blank. Retry reloads a failed prices request.
en.run_note: Start the server-backed app so /api/watchlist and /api/prices exist. A static-file server alone is not enough. Market data needs network access; no AI key is used by this app.
en.footer: A Frankie project by Songhai Fan

zh.headline:
主题自选，
比较价格变化。
zh.intro: 用紧凑的地平线图比较主题自选列表，跨行查看同一位置，也可以减去基准指数的涨跌幅。
zh.concept: 地平线图把不同数值区间折叠到一条窄带里。绿色与红色表示方向，更深的叠层表示更大幅度。本应用用四个色带，让许多段历史能并排排列在同一份列表里。
zh.concept_note: 先看走势，再悬停或触摸读取数值。单看色带高度不能还原完整涨跌幅。原始研究介绍了这种分层方法。
zh.demo_note: 仅用于解释的合成数字，不是行情或交易信号。公式与分带阈值来自实际应用；小图使用直线段，完整应用使用 D3 平滑曲线。
zh.features_title: 先确定，自己在比较什么。
features: D 显示最近的正常交易时段，W 取最近五个交易日；M、6M、Y、5Y、MAX 请求更长历史。每支股票都以返回序列中的第一个收盘价为起点。
S&P 500、Nasdaq 与 Dow 比较，会在相同日期减去指数的收盘价涨跌幅。股票涨 10%、指数涨 6%，就是多出 4 个百分点。当前实现中，缺失的基准日期按零处理。
Global 使用共用日期和数值尺度。Local per stock 把每行各自的历史与幅度拉伸，更容易看清自身走势，但不能直接按同一位置比较绝对幅度与日期。
Normal 等分数值范围。Fibonacci 使用 23.6%、38.2%、61.8% 边界。这只是显示阈值，不是预测或斐波那契回撤工具。
steps: 可以先用 M 看比单个交易日更长的走势，再选择指数，或保留 No benchmark。
悬停或触摸图带，所有行会定位到同一共享位置，右侧增加对应收盘价。移开或松手，恢复显示最新值。
默认保留主题分组，各组按最新变化排序。Rank 将所有行放入同一份排序列表。
向现有主题添加代码；Edit 显示移除按钮。线上列表是服务端工作区，不是私人账号档案。
captions: 真实 M 时段、无基准视图，采集于 2026 年 11 月 6 日；图中数值是数据源快照。
按 S&P 500 超额变化排序，并跨行悬停读取。
列表底部真实的分带与逐股尺度控件。
Edit 模式显示移除入口；本次采集未改动共享代码列表。
data: 价格变化，不是账户收益核算
图表使用返回的收盘价，不计算股息再投资总收益、持仓规模或账户盈亏。Avg 是已加载行的平均值，不是按资金权重计算的组合收益。
经过处理与缓存的行情
服务端请求 Yahoo Finance chart 数据，筛选正常交易时段，并对长序列重采样。所以图线可能是较大序列的缩减视图。日内查询定期刷新，不是逐笔交易行情。
本地服务器把自选 JSON 写在工作目录；Vercel 使用热实例的 /tmp，可能重置，也可能在实例间不同。当前没有账号、持久化的个人自选档案或备份恢复界面。
市场徽标只按纽约的工作日与时间判断，不识别交易所假日。个别代码没有数据或请求失败时，行会留空；Retry 用于重试失败的行情请求。
zh.run_note: 需要启动带服务器的应用，才能提供 /api/watchlist 与 /api/prices；只用静态文件服务器不够。行情需要网络，应用不使用 AI key。
zh.footer: Songhai Fan 的 Frankie 系列项目
